holder-quote: It blinked. The other potions exploded around it. Coating the Wyvern Lord with…liquid? Grimalkin, rising, saw Saliss duck back as the Wyvern Lord whirled, the [Alchemist] leaping out of the way of a breath of frost.
effect-quote: The [Alchemist] threw potions, his hands blurring as he moved.
